history_summary.value: An Indian breed native to the Dhar and Jhabua districts of Madhya Pradesh, prized for its black meat, which many believe has health benefits, and protected by a geographical indication tag since 2018. Rising demand has driven overconsumption and price scams, prompting a state-backed breeding program to prevent the breed's decline.
